name: Stage 51: Bråfalls såg to Nynäs slott
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 51, Bråfalls såg to Nynäs slott.
utilities: Bråfalls såg has parking, picnic/rest shelter, toilet, and bus access near the start.

Nynäs slott is the strong service end with parking, several visitor-area toilets, seasonal visitor services, STF Bränneriet lodging, gardens, and bus access along road 219; restaurant/cafe status must be checked for the current season.
There is no verified drinking-water tap or shop on the forest part of the stage; use Bråfalls/Nynäs services where open.
waterSources: No natural or public drinking-water source was verified on the core stage 51 line.
At Nynäs, use open visitor services, restaurant/hostel access, or ask staff; do not assume an all-hours outdoor tap.
Rundbosjön and small wetlands are natural water only and should be treated if used.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 4 km; Naturkartan measures 3.8 km/3,820 m, OSM relation 6567468 computes about 3.46 km despite a 4 km tag, and the local drawn route is about 3.63 km from Bråfalls såg to the Nynäs mainline/stage-52 handoff. OSM wiki coverage status is stale, but the relation itself was updated in 2026 and is continuous.

Short but hilly Nynäs-reserve stage over north-south rocky ridges, hällmark forest, road 219 crossing, pasture/field edges, and the Mummerberget viewpoint before descending to Nynäs slott. Hiker reports describe it as more rugged than the short length suggests, with repeated ups/downs, rocky footing, and one user-reported rope-supported steep descent near Nynäs.

Local Stage 50/51 and 51/52 snaps are exact. Official pins are nearby aliases: the Bråfalls official start is about 13 m from the local start and the official Stage 52/Nynäs start is about 15 m from the local Stage 51 end. Keep at least 20 m snap tolerance when reconciling sources.

For route-builder imports, use relation/full-GPX geometry rather than routable-way extraction only: OSM relation 6567468 is one connected chain, but one member way lacks highway/path tags and graph routing that ignores it may drop the final approach into Nynäs.
Cattle can occur near Nynäs ladugård from May into autumn. The official page says a fenced passage was built in 2021 to reduce contact and that passage with dogs is risk-free when using it correctly.
Mummerberget is the key rest/viewpoint. From the ridge there are views toward Rundbosjön and a historical lime kiln where osprey often nest on top; the kiln operated from the early 1900s to 1939.

A July 2023 user comment on the official page said the stage was passable but brush sometimes obscured markings at a few points and made the route challenging for children aged 11-13. User reports also mention modest markings at some crossings/ridges. Treat this as older low-confidence navigation context rather than a current fault report.
No current official Stage 51 fault report was found on 2026-04-27. Nynäs/Gisesjön and other loop notices can still affect onward Nynäs Runt planning.

Nynäs reserve rules prohibit tent/hammock/camper overnighting except at designated places and restrict fires/grilling to reserve-managed fireplaces with provided wood. Current 2026 Nynäs notice limits Brevik tenting to designated grass areas during renovation; use designated sites or booked lodging rather than wild camping.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg stage start
facilities.description: Official stage 51 start and stage 50 end at Bråfalls såg.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg heritage
facilities.description: Restored sawmill heritage at the stage start; Nynäs reserve material notes Bråfalls sawed timber for Nynäs slott until the 1940s.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg rastskydd
facilities.description: Picnic/rest shelter at the stage start. OSM maps it as a picnic shelter, not a guaranteed overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg spishus/fireplace
facilities.description: Nynäs/visitor-source context describes a fire-allowed spishus/rest area at Bråfalls såg. Treat exact pin as approximate and use only under current reserve fire rules with provided wood.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped toilet near Bråfalls såg. Verify season/current condition.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg parking
facilities.description: Official stage text says parking is available at Bråfalls såg.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg bus stop
facilities.description: Mapped Sörmlandstrafiken stop east of the start. Verify live departures.

facilities.name: Bråfalls såg bus stop opposite platform
facilities.description: Opposite-direction Sörmlandstrafiken platform east of the start. Verify live departures and walking route along the road.

facilities.name: Road 219 crossing
facilities.description: The route crosses the Trosa-Nyköping coast road/road 219 before more hällmark walking. Use care with live traffic; no special crossing facility was found in official trail text.

facilities.name: Nynäs ladugård cattle passage
facilities.description: Cattle may graze from May into autumn. Use the fenced passage built through the pasture in summer 2021, keep dogs controlled, and close gates. Official wording says dog passage is safe when using the passage correctly. Approximate route-derived pin.

facilities.name: Older stage-level brush/marking note
facilities.description: A July 2023 official-page user comment reported that brush sometimes obscured markings at a few points and made the stage challenging for children aged 11-13. Other user reports mention modest markings at some crossings/ridges. No current official fault was verified; carry the map and watch for orange markers.

facilities.name: Steep/rope-supported descent note
facilities.description: A user report describes a steep descent near Nynäs with a rope for support. Treat as terrain caution for wet rock, tired legs, or dogs, not an official maintained aid guarantee.

facilities.name: Mummerberget viewpoint
facilities.description: Long rocky ridge and recommended rest/viewpoint after about 3 km, over Rundbosjön and the old lime kiln. Länsstyrelsen describes old slow-grown twisted trees and a wide view. Route-derived approximate pin.

facilities.name: Rundbosjön / Evedal lime-kiln view
facilities.description: Off-route view/context from Mummerberget toward the old Evedal lime kiln/kalkbruk area across Rundbosjön; official text notes osprey often nest on top. Viewed object/context, not a visitable on-route facility.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott stage junction
facilities.description: Stage 51 end and stage 52 start by Nynäs slott. The Sörmlandsleden information board is slightly aside by the parking area.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott
facilities.description: Historic castle/manor destination in Nynäs reserve, with seasonal visitor services and gardens.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott parking
facilities.description: Parking at the Nynäs end; official and Naturkartan material list parking in both ends of the stage.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott toilets
facilities.description: Mapped toilet in the Nynäs visitor area; Sörmlands museum notes a large toilet with changing table near the entrance/exhibition area. Opening/season can vary by facility.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott south toilet
facilities.description: Additional mapped visitor-area toilet near the castle/service cluster. Verify opening and season.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott middle toilet
facilities.description: Additional mapped visitor-area toilet between parking and castle. Verify opening and season.

facilities.name: Nynäs slott fountain
facilities.description: Mapped fountain/visitor feature. Do not treat as drinking water unless field-verified.

facilities.name: Restaurang Nynäs / seasonal food
facilities.description: Food/cafe service is seasonal and can change. 2026 Nynäs visitor season is listed as 20 June-16 August, Wednesday-Sunday 11-16, after paused 2025 operations; verify current status before relying on it. Site/service is cash-free.

facilities.name: STF Bränneriet / Nynäs lodging
facilities.description: Hostel/lodging by Rundbosjön a few hundred metres from Nynäs slott and Sörmlandsleden, with self-catering kitchen, toilets/showers for guests, and booked services. Book ahead and do not treat guest services as public all-hours water.

facilities.name: Rundbosjön natural water
facilities.description: Lake-water context by Bränneriet/Nynäs only; not a tested drinking-water source. Treat/filter/boil if used.

facilities.name: Nynäs bus stop
facilities.description: Bus stop along road 219 for Nynäs reserve access, about 500 m from the castle/park. Line 554 is the key corridor; verify live departures because routes/timetables change.

facilities.name: Nynäs bus stop opposite platform
facilities.description: Opposite-direction bus platform along road 219 for Nynäs reserve access. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station train access
facilities.description: Official access text names Vagnhärad railway station for onward bus/taxi planning from the Stockholm side. It is far from both stage ends, so show as remote rail access rather than trail-adjacent transport.

facilities.name: Nyköping C remote train access
facilities.description: Alternative remote rail access from the Nyköping side for onward bus/taxi planning toward Nynäs/Studsvik/Trosa-Vagnhärad corridors. Far from Stage 51; show as remote access only.

facilities.name: Gisesjön shelter burned-down notice
facilities.description: Nynäs notice from 2026-04-09 says the Gisesjön shelter beside the lake and grill place has burned and is currently unusable, with rebuilding planned. Nearby loop context, not on Stage 51 itself.

facilities.name: Nynäs current fire-risk check
facilities.description: No fire ban was found on the Nyköping/Sörmlandskustens page during research, but Länsstyrelsen displayed a forest-fire-risk banner. Check current municipal fire-ban status and Brandrisk Ute before any fire use.

facilities.name: Nynäs reserve camping/fire rules
facilities.description: No tenting in the reserve except designated places, generally max one night; current 2026 notice limits Brevik tenting to designated grass areas during renovation. Fires/grilling only at managed fireplaces with provided wood. Use lodging/stugor at Nynäs instead of informal camping.
